# GamepadAxis

[Framework](README.md) · `DotGame.Framework.Input` · enum

```csharp
public enum GamepadAxis
```

A gamepad's sticks, from -1 to 1 with up and left negative, and its triggers, from 0 to 1. Values are as the hardware reports them, so a game chooses its own dead zone.

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| <a name="leftx"></a>`LeftX` | The left stick's horizontal position. |
| <a name="lefty"></a>`LeftY` | The left stick's vertical position. |
| <a name="rightx"></a>`RightX` | The right stick's horizontal position. |
| <a name="righty"></a>`RightY` | The right stick's vertical position. |
| <a name="lefttrigger"></a>`LeftTrigger` | The left trigger. |
| <a name="righttrigger"></a>`RightTrigger` | The right trigger. |
